Subject: Mutual action plan & proposed owners/dates — OrbitAI POC

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for the time today — great to learn more about the OrbitAI search relevance use case. Per our discovery, I put together a short mutual action plan (attached) to make the POC timeline concrete and avoid chasing loose tasks. Key bullets below: 

- Goal: validate LLM-based reranking for low-latency search across customer product pages.
- Success criteria: >8% CTR uplift on reranked results in A/B within 2 weeks of model rollout; P95 latency < 250ms on 512 tokens.
- Proposed owners/dates (editable):
  • OrbitAI owner: Liam O'Connor — confirm PO/technical point (target: 2026-06-01)
  • Redwood owner: Rafael Mendes — integration & model config (target: 2026-05-28)
  • QA owner: Hannah Simmons (OrbitAI) — test plan & pass criteria (target: 2026-06-04)

Next steps I’m proposing:
1) You confirm owners above or nominate alternates.
2) If owners/dates look good I’ll kick off the HubSpot task and share a calendar for a 30-min sync next week to walk the integration steps.

Attached: Mutual_Action_Plan_OrbitAI_v1.pdf (one-page outline + checklist). If you prefer, I can compress the timeline to a 2-week sprint — happy to adapt to your priorities.

Thanks,
Rafael
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
